# Union Eyes — Route Performance Dashboard

**App:** Union Eyes  
**Region:** Azure Canada Central  
**Source:** Application Insights + OpenTelemetry  

This workbook tracks p50/p95 latency, error rate, and volume for priority routes.  
Thresholds: Green ≤ 500ms p95 · Yellow 500ms–2s · Red > 2s

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in (
    'GET /dashboard/leadership',
    'GET /dashboard/work',
    'GET /grievances/new',
    'POST /api/cases',
    'POST /api/workflow/transition',
    'POST /api/pilot/onboarding'
)
| summarize
    RequestCount = count(),
    ErrorRate = round(100.0 * countif(success == false) / count(), 2),
    P50Ms = round(percentile(duration, 50), 0),
    P95Ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0)
  by name
| order by P95Ms desc
content.title: Priority Route — P50 / P95 Latency

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where name in (
    'POST /api/cases',
    'POST /api/workflow/transition',
    'GET /api/cases'
)
| make-series RequestsPerHour = count() on timestamp from ago(24h) to now() step 1h by name
content.title: Request Volume — 24-hour Trend

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp {TimeRange}
| where success == false
| summarize ErrorCount = count() by name, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| order by ErrorCount desc
| take 20
content.title: Top Error Routes (last window)

content.query:
requests
| where timestamp between (ago(7d) .. ago(1d))
| summarize P95_7d = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by name
| join kind=inner (
    requests
    | where timestamp > ago(1d)
    | summarize P95_1d = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by name
) on name
| extend DeltaMs = P95_1d - P95_7d
| where DeltaMs > 200
| order by DeltaMs desc
content.title: Route Regressions (p95 delta 7d vs 24h, > 200ms worse)
